t: This is Kensington Palace Gardens, an exclusive street near Kensington Palace, entered through gates at either end and guarded by sentry boxes. Several foreign diplomatic missions are along it. During the Second World War and the Cold War it was home to the London Cage, a British government MI19 centre. Many people have lived or died here. The financier Gustav Schwabe, who funded the White Star Line, died here, as did the civil engineer James Meadows Rendel. The historian of Roman roads, Ivan Margary, was born here, and the television personality Tamara Ecclestone lived here.
